items.text: Implement the global flags, command aliases, CI detection, non-interactive/frozen-lockfile behavior, progress rendering, and non-TTY output.
Add typo suggestions and graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation with defined exit codes and temp-data cleanup.
Snapshot-test help and verify cancellation never exposes partial project state.
Implement the documented precedence across CLI, `JSM_*`, project/workspace config, user config, and defaults.
Parse `.npmrc` registry/scope/auth/proxy/TLS settings and environment expansion with documented precedence.
Add `config get|set|list|delete` scopes, validation with file/line/key diagnostics, JSON Schema, and precedence/invalid-input tests.
Parse and preserve supported dependency, script, bin, engine, platform, workspace, override, export, and file fields.
Implement minimal-diff edits that preserve formatting, key order, indentation, and trailing newline.
Add dependency-type and exact/prefix save flags; test round trips against a real-manifest corpus and malformed input.
Implement npm-compatible range grammar, comparator intersection/subset/simplification, prerelease rules, and build metadata handling.
Differential-test generated inputs against the reference npm `semver` implementation; add parser fuzzing and pathological-input tests.
Meet the reference corpus agreement criterion before resolver integration (90,800/90,800 cases).

Complete the specified uninterrupted 24-hour SemVer fuzz campaign. **[DEFERRED: NON-GATING]** Explicitly deferred for Phase 1 closure on 2026-10-07; the run was stopped, was not completed, and has no evidence report.
Implement pooled HTTPS/HTTP2-capable client, abbreviated packuments with full-metadata fallback, ETag/Last-Modified cache, and offline behavior.
Add scoped registry authentication, secret-safe credential handling, proxy/custom CA support, timeouts, retry/backoff, and `Retry-After` handling.
Sanitize all registry metadata before path use; abstract the registry behind a trait for later mirrors/indexes.
Test 304, flaky 5xx, timeout, truncation, auth failure, and cache/offline behavior using the fake registry.
Implement platform-default store paths and overrides through flag, environment, and config.
Implement versioned store layout and sharded SHA-512 blob paths; resolve the open default/per-volume store policy in an ADR.
Implement verified, idempotent temp-write/fsync-policy/atomic-rename blob publication and read-only blob permissions.
Implement per-volume placement or safe link fallback and the specified Store API.
Test concurrent writers, existing-blob skip, invalid hash rejection, and killed-writer recovery.
Store manifests keyed by package name/version/tarball integrity with file path, hash, mode, size, symlink, and package metadata records.
Validate paths, symlink targets, duplicate/case-colliding paths, device entries, and non-standard archive roots before commit.
Make the package manifest the commit point and implement a compact/fast read path for large manifests.
Pass malicious archive tests for traversal, absolute paths, symlink escape, duplicate paths, and decompression bombs.
Stream response bytes through integrity verification, decompression, tar parsing, hashing, CAS writes, and manifest commit without retaining a full tarball.
Bound channels, buffers, per-package and whole-install memory; enforce entry-count, uncompressed-size, path-length, and compression-ratio limits.
Add safe resumable-download support where available and per-package progress events.
Test truncated downloads, hash mismatches, limits, cancellation, memory ceiling, and absence of partially committed packages.
Integrate Resolvo with highest-version default, exact/range/dist-tag resolution, dependency-cycle handling, and lazy parallel metadata retrieval.
Ensure identical metadata and inputs produce identical graphs independent of response timing; report structured conflict details.
Add property tests that every selected package satisfies all constraints and deterministic repeated-run tests.
Implement deterministic, sorted `jsm.lock` serialization with importers, packages, integrity, URL, dependency edges, engine/platform fields, and format/tool versions.
Resolve package-instance identity and lockfile representation for peer-context instances before freezing the format; document in an ADR.
Detect manifest/lockfile staleness; implement newer-major rejection, `--frozen-lockfile`, and `--no-lockfile` semantics.
Test byte-identical output under shuffled inputs and stale cases for add, remove, and changed ranges.
Build the `.jsm` virtual-store layout with direct-dependency top-level links and internal dependency-edge links; write linker state with lockfile hash/settings.
Probe and use reflink, hardlink, then copy fallback; enforce copy/reflink for mutable/script/patch outputs and reject unsafe paths again at link time.
Incrementally update changed entries, preserve the previous valid tree on failure, and remove orphans only after successful commit.
Verify Node can load declared dependencies and undeclared dependencies are not accidentally resolvable.
Support string/map `bin` and `directories.bin`; create Unix executables and Windows `.cmd`/PowerShell shims.
Define deterministic conflict resolution and warnings; document when shebangs are rewritten.
Test executable invocation and conflict behavior on all supported CI operating systems.
Implement `init`, `add`, `install`, `remove`, `run`, `exec`, basic `list`, and basic `why` with documented arguments and aliases.
Implement versioned `--json` output for each baseline command and schema/snapshot tests.
Add end-to-end tests for success, missing package, network/integrity failures, frozen-lockfile errors, and script execution behavior.
Verify SHA-512 tarball integrity and blob hashes before content is committed or linked; make any SHA-1 exception explicit, opt-in, and warned.
Reject traversal and symlink escapes during both extraction and linking.
Ensure dependency lifecycle scripts cannot execute in the Phase 1 binary; test the absence of an execution path.
All baseline commands pass fake-registry end-to-end tests and all in-scope sub-phase criteria are met; follow-ups explicitly marked non-gating are recorded separately.
Exercise the real-registry top-100 package acceptance set and publish a benchmark against npm and pnpm.
Confirm no implicit dependency script execution and no project-visible unverified bytes.
